description: Declares, for every tool an agent can call, the highest tier that tool can ever reach. The gate denies anything not declared here.

description.description: What this tool does, in one line a reviewer can judge.

rationale.description: Why this tier is the right ceiling for this tool. Required in review, optional in schema.

tier.description: read: look/search/fetch, executes immediately. draft: prepares content that stays inside the system, executes immediately. send: leaves the system or commits you in front of another person, blocked until a human approves.
